procedure: Read all 50 evidence-only cases before running either prediction arm; source-guided agent judgments, no human adjudication.
rubric: Modern inventory overlap, allowing conservative partial labels for clear shared uses; inactive-only overlap stays qualified. Related conceptual/grammatical readings may have several admissible labels. Spelling redirects without definitions remain unresolved. Display assesses an ordinary useful paired headline, separately from valid secondary matches.
